recommendation: Keep the source fix as-is. It completes the partially applied FHIR-51693 DiagnosticReport alias change and lets the generated diagnostics module alias table reflect the approved list; handle FHIR-51694 separately if that ServiceRequest issue needs audit.
issue_request: FHIR-51693 was Applied with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for R6. The final request was to use Observation aliases Vital Sign, Measurement, Result, Test Performed, Observable and DiagnosticReport aliases Report, Labs, Test Report, and to have those aliases display correctly on the diagnostics module page.
initial_application: Upstream commit 749260ebe9de47e490f38c91b578b4832bb94c1e updated Observation to the voted list and added DiagnosticReport alias Test Report, but it left the obsolete DiagnosticReport aliases Test, Result, Results, and Laboratory in the active StructureDefinition.
additional_context: The OO LAB minutes from 2025-08-15 explicitly record removing Test/Tests, Result/Results, and Laboratory from DiagnosticReport while adding Test Report. source/fhir.ini lists DiagnosticReport and Observation as active resources, and source/diagnostics-module.html renders them with [%res-item%], so the StructureDefinition aliases feed the module table. FHIR-51694 is a related ServiceRequest alias issue but concerns a separate resource.
reconciliation: Changed source/diagnosticreport/structuredefinition-DiagnosticReport.xml to leave only the approved top-level aliases Report, Labs, and Test Report. Observation already matched FHIR-51693 and was not edited.
source_changes: source/diagnosticreport/structuredefinition-DiagnosticReport.xml: removed stale top-level DiagnosticReport aliases Test, Result, Results, and Laboratory.
